title: Carefree Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: The interior of the home is designed to delight and accommodate. High ceilings and ample windows ensure that the space is bathed in natural light, enhancing the carefully selected designer decor and modern furnishings. The main living area features a comfortable layout with a large dining table for six, and a cozy living room centered around a 55" flat-screen TV—perfect for family gatherings. The chef’s kitchen is a culinary dream, boasting a spacious island with bar seating, granite countertops, and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, making home-cooked meals an enjoyable affair. Upstairs, the magic continues with a custom-built loft for kids, and bedrooms each with their private ensuites, ensuring privacy and comfort for all guests. This home doesn’t just offer a place to stay; it promises a luxurious living experience in one of the most beautiful settings along the Gulf Coast.
